errors.nicknameInvalid: Use at most {{max}} characters, with no control characters.

notices.saveFailed: The profile could not be saved. Try again.
notices.copyFailed: The ID could not be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.

fingerprint.title: Your key fingerprint
fingerprint.explanation: Your reports are signed with a key that never leaves this device. Read these characters to a friend in person: if they match what their app shows for you, every report they get from you is really yours.
fingerprint.missing: This device has no signing key yet, so there is nothing to compare.

data.title: Your data
data.explanation: Save all your data to a file you choose, or load it back from one. Nothing is sent anywhere.

overwrite.title: Replace your data?
overwrite.message: Importing replaces everything on this device with the content of the file. Your current data cannot be recovered afterwards.

otherUser.title: This file belongs to someone else
otherUser.message: The file was exported by another user. If you import it, this device loses its signing key and your friends will see a key change on your next report.

notices.exportFailed: The data could not be exported. Try again.
notices.importDamaged: This file is damaged or is not a VitaPact backup. Nothing was changed.
notices.importUnknownVersion: This backup comes from a newer version of VitaPact. Update the app, then try again. Nothing was changed.
notices.importFailed: The data could not be imported. Nothing was changed.

groups.title: Groups
groups.stakeRotates: Stake: a new one every week

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.message: The group and its rankings disappear from this device. Your friends and their reports stay.

dialog.name: Group name
dialog.stakeChoice: How do you pick the stake?
dialog.stakeRotatingHint: Every week the app picks the stake for you, like the pizza or a round of beers. Everyone in the group sees the same one.
dialog.stakePlaceholder: e.g. whoever falls behind buys the pizza
dialog.noFriendsYet: No friends to add yet. You can add them later, when their first report arrives.
dialog.saveFailed: The group could not be saved. Try again.

deleteAll.title: Delete all data
deleteAll.explanation: Removes your profile, days, weigh-ins, friends, groups and notes from this device. Export your data first if you may want it back.
deleteAll.failed: The data could not be deleted. Nothing was changed.

first.title: Delete everything?
first.message: Everything VitaPact keeps on this device will be deleted, including your signing key. This cannot be undone.

second.title: Are you sure?
second.message: Type DELETE to confirm. The app then starts again from the welcome.
second.label: Type DELETE

about.title: About
about.dataLocationText: Only on this computer, in the app's own folder (on Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\com.vitapact.app). Nothing is kept online.
